summary_en: This note explains the idea of discrete summation by parts for estimating sums of the form \(\sum a_n b_n\), especially when the partial sums of \(b_n\) are controllable and the differences of \(a_n\) are simple. It illustrates how this viewpoint underlies convergence tests such as Leibniz, Dirichlet, and Abel-type arguments, and shows several applications and variants.

problems.statement_en: Find a closed-form expression for \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} k2^k\).

problems.statement_zh: 我们需要判断\(\sum_{n\geq }\frac{\sin(\sqrt{n})}{n}\)是否收敛。

problems.statement_en: Given that \(\sum_{n\leq N} e(kx_n)=o_k(N)\), determine whether \(\sum_{n\leq N} e(kx_n+k\log(n))=o_k(N)\) also holds, in the context of Weyl's criterion.
problems.statement_zh: 当中我们已知\(\sum_{n\leq N}e(kx_n)=o_k(N)\)我们需要判断是否\(\sum_{n\leq N}e(kx_n+k\log(n))=o_k(N)\)基于Weyl判别。

problems.statement_en: Prove the convergence of the double series \(\sum_{n\geq 1}\sum_{k\geq 1}\frac{(-1)^{\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor}}{n^2+k^2}\).
problems.statement_zh: 这个问题中我们需要证明\(\sum_{n\geq 1}\sum_{k\geq 1}\frac{(-1)^{\lfloor\sqrt{n}\rfloor}}{n^2+k^2}\)的收敛性。

problems.statement_en: Estimate \(S_n:=\sum_{k\leq n} x_k^p=o(n^p)\) under the assumptions that \(x_k=o(k)\) and that the partial sums \(A_n:=\sum_{k\leq n} x_k\) satisfy \(A_n<C\).
problems.statement_zh: 其中为了完成估计任务：\(S_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}x_k^p=o(n^p)\)已知信息\(x_k = o(k)\)暗示我们可以进行分段估计，但是单纯的分段估计只能得到\(o(n^{p+1})\)的估计，达不到目标精度。不过问题当中还包含序列部分和\(A_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}x_k\),并且已知\(A_n<C\)的信息。

key_techniques_discussed: estimating sums via partial sums of one factor and differences of the other
Dirichlet and Abel type convergence arguments
Euler-Maclaurin summation for finer partial-sum estimates
majorize first, then apply summation by parts
